book: Start here · From EMR to PCP
title: What changes when you step up from EMR to PCP
next: BC exam drugs, Lesson 1: Drugs you already give as an EMR, and what changes

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already run the scene, the primary survey, oxygen, bleeding control, splints and the EMR drugs. Today, as a PCP:

  1. See every place the BC protocols give the PCP extra tools
  2. Know what you must do more of: assess, decide, reassess, document
  3. Spot the new hazards that never mattered as an EMR

BC source: EMALB Provincial Examination Guidelines (current to June 15, 2026), protocol pages 19–57
slides.say: Welcome to the first lesson of the course. You all hold an EMR licence, so you already make scenes safe, do primary surveys, give oxygen, control bleeding, splint, and give the EMR drugs. None of that goes away. Everything you do as an EMR, you still do as a PCP. What changes is what you add on top. Today we'll do three things. First, we'll walk through every BC protocol that has a PCP section, and sort the new tools into groups. Second, we'll talk about what you must now do more of. And third, we'll look at the new hazards that come with those new tools.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎来到本课程的第一课。你们都持有 EMR 执照，已经会确保现场安全、做初步评估、给氧、止血、固定，也会给 EMR 的药物。这些都不会消失：EMR 做的每一件事，PCP 照样要做。变化的是在这之上多出来的部分。今天讲三件事：第一，逐一过一遍所有带 PCP 部分的 BC 流程，把新工具分组；第二，讲你现在必须多做的事；第三，看看新工具带来的新风险。

slides.title: How every BC protocol is built
slides.body:
All levels"Interventions of all License Levels"EMR and PCP
PCP only"Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions"added on top
16protocols have a PCP sectionthe CPAP guideline is PCP-only too

The PCP list adds to the all-levels list; it never replaces it. Many PCP steps carry a timing word: "en route" or "on scene".
slides.say: Before the details, let's look at how BC writes its protocols, because the exam is built on this layout. Each protocol has a list called "Interventions of all License Levels". That's what an EMR and a PCP both do. Many protocols then have a second list: "Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions". That list is for PCPs only. Sixteen protocols have one, and the whole CPAP guideline is labelled PCP. Two things to notice. The PCP list is added on top; it never replaces the first list. And many PCP steps carry a timing word, like "en route" or "on scene". The timing is part of the protocol, so learn it with the step.
slides.sayZh: 讲细节之前，先看 BC 流程是怎么写的，因为考试就是按这个结构出的。每个流程都有一栏叫「所有执照级别的处置」，也就是 EMR 和 PCP 都要做的。很多流程还有第二栏：「PCP 额外处置」，只有 PCP 能做。一共有十六个流程带这一栏，另外整份 CPAP 指引都标明是 PCP 专属。注意两点：PCP 那一栏是叠加在上面的，从来不取代第一栏；很多 PCP 步骤带有时间词，比如「转运途中」或「在现场」。时间也是流程的一部分，要和步骤一起记。

slides.title: Sixteen protocols with a PCP section
slides.body:
GroupProtocols
Trauma (6)Traumatic brain injury, burns, abdominal injuries, chest trauma, electrical contact, hypovolemia
Medical (7)Stroke, cardiac chest pain, nausea–vomiting, asthma/COPD, anaphylaxis, narcotic overdose, diabetic emergencies
Breathing & environment (3)CHF / pulmonary edema, drowning, heat exhaustion / heatstroke

No PCP section: wound care, fractures and splints, spinal care, hypothermia, choking.
slides.say: Here are the sixteen protocols with a PCP section, in three groups. Six are trauma: head injury, burns, abdominal and chest injuries, electrical contact, and hypovolemia, which means low blood volume. Seven are medical: stroke, cardiac chest pain, nausea and vomiting, asthma or COPD, which is chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, anaphylaxis, narcotic overdose, and diabetic emergencies. Three are about breathing and the environment: congestive heart failure with fluid in the lungs, drowning, and heat illness. Notice what's missing. Wound care, fractures, spinal care, hypothermia and choking have no PCP section. On those calls your hands-on skills are the same as an EMR's, but your assessment should be deeper.
slides.sayZh: 这是十六个带 PCP 部分的流程，分三组。六个是创伤：颅脑外伤、烧伤、腹部和胸部损伤、电击伤，以及低血容量，也就是血容量不足。七个是内科：卒中、心源性胸痛、恶心呕吐、哮喘或 COPD（慢性阻塞性肺疾病）、过敏性休克、麻醉类药物过量、糖尿病急症。三个和呼吸及环境有关：充血性心衰伴肺水肿、溺水、中暑。再看看缺了什么：伤口处理、骨折、脊柱处理、低体温和气道异物都没有 PCP 部分。这些出车里你的动手技能和 EMR 一样，但评估要更深入。

slides.title: Toolbox 1: IV access and fluids
slides.body:
Bolus: 20 mL/kg, max 2 L, reassess every 500 mL

  • IV or fluids appear in 13 of the 16 PCP sections
  • Two jobs: replace lost fluid, and give IV drugs
  • Nausea–vomiting: bolus target is a systolic of 90
  • Stroke: 18 G, above the wrist, right side preferred
  • TBI: run the IV TKVO once the systolic is above 120
slides.say: Your biggest new tool is vascular access, which means an IV line. It appears in thirteen of the sixteen PCP sections, and BC gives it two jobs: replacing lost fluid, as in hypovolemia and burns, and giving medications. When you give a fluid bolus, the number is almost always the same: twenty millilitres per kilogram, up to two litres, reassessing after every five hundred millilitres. Some protocols add a detail. In nausea and vomiting, the target is a systolic pressure of ninety. In stroke, use an eighteen gauge catheter above the wrist, preferably on the right. In head injury, once the systolic is above one hundred twenty, the IV runs TKVO, which means just enough to keep the vein open.
slides.sayZh: 你最大的新工具是血管通路，也就是静脉输液。十六个 PCP 部分里有十三个提到它。BC 给它两个用途：补充丢失的液体（比如低血容量和烧伤），以及给药。补液推注的数字几乎都一样：每公斤二十毫升，最多两升，每五百毫升复评一次。有些流程另有细节：恶心呕吐的目标收缩压是九十；卒中用十八号留置针，选手腕以上，最好在右侧；颅脑外伤收缩压一旦高于一百二十，静脉就只以 TKVO 速度滴，也就是刚好保持静脉通畅。

slides.title: Toolbox 2: CPAP and PEEP
slides.body:
• CPAP: consider in CHF, asthma, COPD, drowning, pneumonia
  • Needs: age 13+, awake, follows commands, keeps own airway
  • Plus: RR > 24, SpO₂ < 94% on O₂, accessory muscle use
  • Start at 5 cmH₂O, up in steps of 2.5, max 10
  • PEEP valve on the BVM: start at 5 cmH₂O, max 10
  • No CPAP if systolic < 90; remove PEEP if systolic < 90
slides.say: Your second toolbox is airway pressure. CPAP, or continuous positive airway pressure, is a mask that keeps steady pressure in the airways, so the small air sacs stay open and breathing takes less work. BC lists it for heart failure, asthma, COPD, drowning and pneumonia. The patient must be thirteen or older, awake, following commands and keeping their own airway, breathing faster than twenty-four, with a saturation under ninety-four percent on oxygen, and using accessory muscles. Start at five centimetres of water, go up in steps of two point five, to a maximum of ten. PEEP, or positive end-expiratory pressure, is a valve on the bag-valve mask, with the same start and maximum.
slides.sayZh: 第二个工具箱是气道压力。CPAP（持续气道正压）是一个面罩，让气道保持稳定的压力，小肺泡就能保持张开，呼吸更省力。BC 列出的适用情况有心衰、哮喘、COPD、溺水和肺炎。病人必须年满十三岁、清醒、能听从指令、能自己维持气道，呼吸频率超过二十四、给氧下血氧低于百分之九十四、有辅助呼吸肌参与。从五厘米水柱开始，每次加二点五，最高十。PEEP（呼气末正压）是装在球囊面罩上的阀门，起始值和上限相同。

slides.q: A 74-year-old with heart failure is awake and following commands. RR 32, SpO₂ 87% on oxygen, accessory muscle use, BP 84/52. You are the PCP. What about CPAP?
options: Start CPAP at 5 cmH₂O and reassess
No CPAP: the systolic is below 90
Start CPAP at 10 cmH₂O, the maximum
No CPAP: it is only for asthma
slides.say: Let's pause for a PCP decision. A seventy-four-year-old with heart failure is awake and following commands. Breathing rate thirty-two, saturation eighty-seven percent on oxygen, using accessory muscles, blood pressure eighty-four over fifty-two. You are the PCP. What about CPAP? A, start CPAP at five and reassess. B, no CPAP, because the systolic is below ninety. C, start CPAP at ten, the maximum. D, no CPAP, because it's only for asthma. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 停一下，做个 PCP 决策。一位七十四岁心衰病人，清醒，能听从指令；呼吸三十二次，给氧下血氧百分之八十七，用辅助呼吸肌，血压八十四比五十二。你是 PCP，CPAP 怎么办？A 从五开始上 CPAP 再复评；B 不上 CPAP，因为收缩压低于九十；C 直接上到最高值十；D 不上，CPAP 只用于哮喘。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. This patient meets every CPAP criterion but one: a systolic under ninety is on the BC list of contraindications, because pressure in the chest can push the blood pressure even lower. A would be right with a normal blood pressure. C is wrong twice: CPAP starts at five, and it's contraindicated here anyway. D is wrong because heart failure is a main reason BC lists for CPAP.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。这位病人满足 CPAP 的所有条件，只差一条：收缩压低于九十在 BC 的禁忌症清单上，因为胸腔内的压力会让血压更低。血压正常的话 A 才对。C 错两处：CPAP 从五开始，而且这里本来就禁用。D 错，心衰正是 BC 列出的 CPAP 主要适用情况。

slides.title: Toolbox 3: seven PCP-only drugs
slides.body:
DrugWhere it appears
D10WDiabetic emergencies
OndansetronNausea–vomiting
DimenhydrinateNausea–vomiting, cardiac chest pain
DiphenhydramineAnaphylaxis
Ipratropium, dexamethasoneAsthma / COPD
TXAHypovolemia, abdominal and chest trauma

TXA is contraindicated in an isolated head injury.

After you are hired, BCEHS adds more drugs through Schedule 1/2 training (e.g. ketorolac, intranasal ketamine, palliative morphine). Your school teaches them; the licensing exam does not test them.
slides.say: Your third toolbox is the drugs. The BC exam list has eighteen drugs. Eleven you already give as an EMR. Seven are new, and only PCPs give them. D10W treats low blood sugar in diabetic emergencies. Ondansetron and dimenhydrinate treat nausea, and dimenhydrinate also appears in cardiac chest pain. Diphenhydramine is added in anaphylaxis. Ipratropium and dexamethasone help in asthma and COPD. TXA, or tranexamic acid, appears in hypovolemia and in abdominal and chest trauma, but it's contraindicated when a head injury is the only injury. One more thing: after you're hired, BCEHS adds drugs like ketorolac, intranasal ketamine and palliative morphine through Schedule one and two training. Your school teaches them; the licensing exam does not, so on the exam, stay with the eighteen.
slides.sayZh: 第三个工具箱是药物。BC 考试药物清单共有十八种，其中十一种你当 EMR 时已经在用，七种是新的，只有 PCP 能给。D10W（百分之十葡萄糖）用于糖尿病急症里的低血糖；昂丹司琼和茶苯海明治恶心，茶苯海明在心源性胸痛流程里也出现；苯海拉明加在过敏性休克流程里；异丙托溴铵和地塞米松用于哮喘和 COPD；TXA（氨甲环酸）出现在低血容量、腹部和胸部创伤流程里，但单纯颅脑外伤禁用。再补一句：入职以后，BCEHS 会通过 Schedule 1 和 2 的培训再加一些药，比如 ketorolac、鼻内 ketamine 和姑息用的吗啡。学校会教，执照考试不考，所以考试还是只按这十八种。

slides.title: Toolbox 4: old drugs, new uses
slides.body:
• Naloxone IV if still unconscious and apneic
  • Epinephrine IM for severe bronchospasm not fixed by salbutamol
  • Salbutamol with ipratropium in the same nebulizer
  • Anaphylaxis: salbutamol for wheeze after the epinephrine
  • Glucagon becomes the backup: only if no IV
slides.say: The fourth change is quieter: drugs you already carry get new uses. In narcotic overdose, if the patient stays unconscious and isn't breathing, the PCP can start an IV and give naloxone intravenously. In asthma or COPD, intramuscular epinephrine is on the PCP list for severe bronchospasm, for example a saturation under ninety percent despite salbutamol. Salbutamol can now share a nebulizer with ipratropium. In anaphylaxis, the PCP list treats bronchospasm with salbutamol after the epinephrine. And glucagon changes its role. As an EMR, it's your answer for a patient who can't protect their airway. As a PCP, you start an IV and give D10W, and glucagon is the backup.
slides.sayZh: 第四个变化比较低调：你本来就带的药有了新用法。阿片类过量时，如果病人一直昏迷、没有呼吸，PCP 可以开静脉、静脉推注纳洛酮。哮喘或 COPD 时，严重支气管痉挛（比如用了沙丁胺醇血氧仍低于百分之九十）可以肌注肾上腺素，这在 PCP 那一栏。沙丁胺醇现在可以和异丙托溴铵放进同一个雾化器。过敏性休克时，PCP 那一栏规定在肾上腺素之后用沙丁胺醇处理支气管痉挛。胰高血糖素的角色也变了：当 EMR 时，它是不能自护气道病人的答案；当 PCP 时，你先开静脉给 D10W，胰高血糖素变成备用方案。

slides.title: Numbers you now own
slides.body:
TopicBC number
Fluid bolus20 mL/kg, max 2 L, reassess every 500 mL
Nausea–vomiting bolustarget systolic 90
Head injury (TBI)systolic > 120; glucose 4.0–8.0 mmol/L
HypoglycemiaBGL < 4.0 → D10W 10–25 g IV
CPAP / PEEPstart 5 cmH₂O, max 10
TXAwithin 3 h of injury; not under 12
slides.say: New tools come with new numbers. The fluid bolus is twenty millilitres per kilogram, up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred. In nausea and vomiting, you aim for a systolic of ninety. In a traumatic brain injury you aim higher: a systolic above one hundred twenty, and a blood sugar between four and eight millimoles per litre, because both low pressure and abnormal sugar harm an injured brain. Low blood sugar means under four, and the PCP answer is ten to twenty-five grams of D10W. CPAP and PEEP both start at five and stop at ten. And TXA has a clock: within three hours of the injury, and never under age twelve.
slides.sayZh: 新工具带来新数字。补液推注每公斤二十毫升、最多两升、每五百复评。恶心呕吐的目标收缩压是九十。颅脑外伤目标更高：收缩压一百二十以上，血糖四到八毫摩尔每升，因为低血压和血糖异常都会伤害受损的大脑。低血糖指低于四，PCP 的处理是 D10W 十到二十五克。CPAP 和 PEEP 都从五开始、到十为止。TXA 有时钟：受伤三小时以内，而且十二岁以下禁用。

slides.q: A cyclist has an isolated head injury. GCS 11, BP 104/70, BGL 6.2 mmol/L. You are the PCP and the IV is in. Which plan fits the BC TBI protocol?
options: Run the IV TKVO: 104 is a normal pressure
Aim for a systolic above 120, glucose 4.0–8.0, head of bed at 30°
Give TXA 2 g IV push over 1 minute
Lay him flat to raise his blood pressure
slides.say: Another PCP decision. A cyclist has an isolated head injury: Glasgow Coma Scale eleven, blood pressure one hundred four over seventy, sugar six point two. You're the PCP and the IV is in. Which plan fits the BC protocol? A, run the IV to keep the vein open, because one hundred four is normal. B, aim for a systolic above one hundred twenty and a glucose of four to eight, head of the bed at thirty degrees. C, give TXA, two grams IV push. D, lay him flat to raise his pressure. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 再来一道 PCP 决策题。一位骑车人单纯颅脑外伤：GCS 十一分，血压一百零四比七十，血糖六点二。你是 PCP，静脉已开好。哪个方案符合 BC 流程？A 静脉只保持通畅，因为一百零四是正常血压；B 目标收缩压一百二十以上、血糖四到八，床头抬高三十度；C 给 TXA 两克静推；D 让他平躺以升高血压。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. In head injury, BC asks the PCP to keep the systolic above one hundred twenty and the glucose between four and eight, and everyone raises the head of the bed to thirty degrees. A is wrong: TKVO is only for a systolic already above one hundred twenty. C is wrong: TXA is contraindicated in an isolated head injury. D is wrong: the protocol raises the head of the bed.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。颅脑外伤时，BC 要求 PCP 维持收缩压一百二十以上、血糖四到八；所有级别都要把床头抬高三十度。A 错：只有收缩压已经高于一百二十才用 TKVO 速度。C 错：单纯颅脑外伤禁用 TXA。D 错：流程要求的是抬高床头。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: the big picture
slides.body:
All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Scene safety, primary survey, transport decision
  • Oxygen to SpO₂ ≥ 94%, BVM, positioning
  • Bleeding control, splints, pelvic binder, spinal care
  • Glucose check; glucose gel; glucagon; naloxone
  • ASA, nitro, salbutamol, epinephrine IM, pain relief

PCP adds

  • IV access and fluid boluses
  • CPAP, and PEEP on the BVM
  • Seven PCP-only drugs
  • New uses for old drugs (IV naloxone, etc.)
  • Targets: TBI systolic > 120, glucose 4.0–8.0
  • Supraglottic airway (SGA) in cardiac arrest
slides.say: Let's put it side by side. On the left is what both licences do: scene safety, the primary survey and the transport decision; oxygen, bag-valve-mask ventilation and positioning; bleeding control, splints, the pelvic binder and spinal care; a glucose check, glucose gel and glucagon; naloxone; and drugs like aspirin, nitroglycerin, salbutamol, epinephrine and pain relief. On the right is what the PCP adds: an IV and fluid boluses; CPAP and PEEP; the seven new drugs; new uses for old drugs; physiological targets, like a systolic above one hundred twenty in head injury; and, in cardiac arrest, the BC guideline mentions a supraglottic airway, or SGA, for PCPs.
slides.sayZh: 把两边放在一起看。左边是两种执照都做的：现场安全、初步评估和转运决策；给氧、球囊面罩通气和体位；止血、夹板、骨盆带和脊柱处理；测血糖、葡萄糖凝胶和胰高血糖素；纳洛酮；以及阿司匹林、硝酸甘油、沙丁胺醇、肾上腺素和镇痛药。右边是 PCP 加的：静脉通路和补液推注；CPAP 和 PEEP；七种新药；老药的新用法；生理目标值，比如颅脑外伤收缩压一百二十以上；还有心搏骤停时，BC 指引提到 PCP 可以用声门上气道，也就是 SGA。

slides.title: One call, two licences: low sugar
slides.body:
Diabetic emergencies protocol. Hypoglycemia = BGL < 4.0 mmol/L.

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Airway, O₂ to SpO₂ ≥ 94%, lateral position if needed
  • History, vitals, blood glucose; check for stroke
  • Can protect airway → glucose gel
  • EMR, can't protect airway → glucagon

PCP adds

  • Obtain vascular access
  • Confirmed hypoglycemia → D10W 10–25 g (100–250 mL)
  • Glucagon only if you can't get an IV
  • Transport after the first D10W bolus or glucagon
slides.say: Here's one call seen through both licences: a diabetic patient with a decreased level of consciousness. Both of you manage the airway, give oxygen, check the blood glucose, and look for signs of stroke. If the sugar is under four and the patient can protect their airway, both of you give glucose gel. Now the paths split. If the patient can't protect their airway, the EMR gives glucagon. The PCP starts an IV instead and gives ten to twenty-five grams of D10W, which is one hundred to two hundred fifty millilitres. Glucagon is the PCP's backup, only if the IV fails. And the PCP starts transport after that first bolus.
slides.sayZh: 同一个出车，用两种执照来看：一位意识水平下降的糖尿病病人。你们都要处理气道、给氧、测血糖、查卒中体征。血糖低于四、病人能自护气道，两者都给葡萄糖凝胶。接下来就分开了：如果病人不能自护气道，EMR 给胰高血糖素；PCP 则开静脉，给 D10W 十到二十五克，也就是一百到二百五十毫升。胰高血糖素是 PCP 的备用方案，只在静脉开不了时用。PCP 在第一次推注后开始转运。

slides.title: What you must now do more of
slides.body:
• Assess deeper: the "why", plus the PCP-only functional enquiry
  • Decide: "consider" and "if indicated" mean your judgment
  • Reassess every 500 mL and after every bolus
  • IV running: recheck patient and line every 5–15 min
  • Chest pain: vital signs every 5 minutes
  • Document: record SpO₂ changes as you treat
slides.say: New tools mean more thinking. The PCP lists are full of words like "consider" and "if indicated", and those words mean the decision is yours. To decide well you need the why, the physiology behind each finding. BC's assessment model also makes the functional enquiry, a system-by-system review, required for PCPs only. You also reassess much more, and BC builds it into the protocols: after every five hundred millilitres, after every bolus, vital signs every five minutes in chest pain, and the patient and the IV every five to fifteen minutes. And you document: the oxygen guideline asks you to record how the saturation changes as you treat. The COPR written exam, from the Canadian Organization of Paramedic Regulators, rewards the same skill.
slides.sayZh: 新工具意味着更多思考。PCP 那一栏到处是「考虑」「如有指征」这样的词，意思是由你来决定。要决定得好，就要懂原因，也就是每个发现背后的生理机制。BC 的评估模型还规定系统问诊（functional enquiry，逐个系统地询问）是 PCP 必做、EMR 不做的。你还要复评得多得多，BC 已经把复评写进流程：每五百毫升之后、每次推注之后；胸痛每五分钟测一次生命体征；开着静脉时每五到十五分钟检查一次病人和管路。还要记录：给氧指引要求你记下治疗过程中血氧的变化。PCP 笔试由 COPR（加拿大护理人员监管机构组织）出题，考的也是同一种能力。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Never delay transport for an IV; many PCP steps say "en route"
  • IV problems: infiltration, phlebitis, circulatory overload
  • Fluids have limits: 20 mL/kg, max 2 L; stop and reassess
  • No CPAP: systolic < 90, trauma, pneumothorax, vomiting, age ≤ 12
  • Every new drug has hard stops, e.g. TXA after 3 h or under 12
  • You own the dose: weight, route, timing, maximum
slides.say: Now the hazards that never mattered when you were an EMR. First, an IV must never hold up transport; that's why so many PCP steps say "en route". Second, the IV itself can cause harm: infiltration, which means fluid leaking into the tissue around the vein; phlebitis, an inflamed vein; and circulatory overload, when you give more fluid than the heart and lungs can handle. Third, fluids have limits, so stop and reassess. Fourth, CPAP has a long list of contraindications, including a systolic under ninety, trauma, a pneumothorax, vomiting, and age twelve or under. And fifth, every new drug has hard stops. You own the dose now.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲当 EMR 时不用操心的风险。第一，静脉永远不能拖延转运，所以很多 PCP 步骤写着「转运途中」。第二，静脉本身会出问题：渗漏，就是液体漏到血管周围组织；静脉炎，就是静脉发炎；还有循环超负荷，就是输的液体超出心肺能承受的量。第三，补液有上限，要停下来复评。第四，CPAP 禁忌症很多，包括收缩压低于九十、创伤、气胸、呕吐、十二岁及以下。第五，每种新药都有硬禁忌。现在剂量由你负责。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. The PCP list is added on top of the all-levels list, never instead
  2. New tools: IV/fluids, CPAP/PEEP, 7 drugs, new uses for old drugs
  3. More thinking: decide, reassess after every step, document

Next: drugs you already give as an EMR, and what changes
slides.say: Let's wrap up with three things to remember. One: in every BC protocol, the PCP list is added on top of the all-levels list. It never replaces it. Two: your new tools come in four groups: IV access and fluids; CPAP and PEEP; seven PCP-only drugs; and new uses for drugs you already know. Three: being a PCP means more thinking: deciding when a protocol says "consider", reassessing after every intervention, and documenting what changed. Next lesson, we'll go through the eleven drugs you already give as an EMR and see exactly what changes for each one. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 收尾三句话。一，每个 BC 流程里，PCP 那一栏都是叠加在所有级别那一栏之上，从不取代它。二，你的新工具分四组：静脉通路和补液；CPAP 和 PEEP；七种 PCP 专用药；老药的新用法。三，当 PCP 意味着更多思考：流程写「考虑」时由你决定，每次处置后复评，记录变化。下节课逐一讲你当 EMR 时已经在给的十一种药，看看每一种具体有什么变化。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
